findings.title: The 'initReviewSubmit is a no-op off the review page' test has zero explicit assertions (only proves no-throw) — optional hardening
findings.evidence: test("initReviewSubmit is a no-op off the review page (the form page path)", () => { const env = { document: { querySelector: () => null }, Date: { now: () => 0 } }; referenceForm._initReviewSubmit(env); // must not throw }); — no assert.* calls.
findings.detail: Filed as warning by blind; lead-verified the impact is lower: the seam's `if (!form) return` bail means a removed guard would throw on null.addEventListener, so the no-throw IS an implicit defense. The load-bearing contracts (bind+populate+no-preventDefault+floor) are pinned by the other 3 tests. Downgraded to note — explicit assertion would be nicer, not required.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: assert the env's fake form had addEventListener never called (e.g. a spy counter), making the no-op explicit. Ship-blocking: no.
